drafts.requirement: The game must refine combat mechanics to ensure responsive and fluid interactions, reducing clunkiness and improving player satisfaction.
drafts.why: Players experience combat as clunky, unpolished, and unenjoyable, detracting from overall game immersion.
drafts.proposed_change: Enhance combat responsiveness by optimizing input detection, balancing stamina usage, and refining enemy AI to provide a more fluid and engaging combat experience.
drafts.check: Post-change reviews should indicate improved combat fluidity, responsiveness, and enjoyment, with fewer mentions of clunkiness or frustration.

drafts.requirement: The game must improve movement responsiveness and reduce animation delays for actions like dodging and jetpacking.
drafts.why: Players experience unresponsive controls and delayed animations, making evasion and movement frustrating.
drafts.proposed_change: Optimize control responsiveness and streamline animations for dodging, jetpacking, and other movement actions.
drafts.check: Reviews should indicate smoother movement and more responsive controls, with fewer complaints about animation delays.

drafts.requirement: The game must adjust enemy damage output to ensure player health is not depleted by a single hit from evenly-matched enemies.
drafts.why: Players experience frustration from being one-hit KO'd by enemies, disrupting gameplay balance.
drafts.proposed_change: Reduce the damage dealt by enemies to allow players to survive multiple hits, enhancing survivability and balance.
drafts.check: Reviews should indicate improved player survivability and balanced encounters, with fewer complaints about one-hit deaths.

synthesis.summary: To enhance player satisfaction, the game should first address combat dynamics [R1], movement and evasion [R2], and enemy strength and balance [R3] to ensure responsive and balanced gameplay. It is crucial to maintain the early game difficulty [A1] and overall difficulty [A2] as they contribute positively to player mastery and challenge. Additionally, the game should preserve elements like story engagement [P1], world building [P2], and factions and lore [P3] to maintain immersion and player engagement.
